outcome.technical: audit-task.py: settle gains --task ID (parser flag, VERB_FLAGS['settle']=('task',), usage line). _locked_settle with --task refuses an unknown task (exit 2, names it and lists tasks), skips _settle over phase/bug values and the stale index stubs, and passes the id to _settle_wide_gates (new only_task parameter) so only that task's gate is written and only its phase's shard (_write_add per moved phase) is rewritten; a task with nothing stale prints 'nothing to settle' naming the task. drive-phase.py settle_stale_gate: runs 'settle <manifest> --task ID', docstring says why, and when the verb exits 0 but the task's gate list did not move it reports "<id>'s gate did not move: audit-task.py settle exited 0 and the task still holds <gate>" instead of 'settled: X -> X'. Tests: ssg5 (sharded two-phase plan, both tasks called stale by the plan; start P1.1 -> P1.1 narrowed, P2.1 gate and P2 shard bytes unchanged) and ssg6 (settle stubbed to exit 0 with no move) in tests/test_drive_phase.py; wgt1-wgt7 (new block wgt-block, _settle_task_scope_cases) in tests/test_audit_task.py: scoped settle changes only its phase's shard (journal excluded, index/stub/bug untouched), one journal row naming the task, unscoped settle still settles the sibling task, bug status and stub (allow twin), nothing-stale, unknown task refusal, another verb refuses --task. Mutations proved red, each restored byte-identical with __pycache__ purged: drop --task from the drive call -> ssg5 red; drop the unmoved check -> ssg6 red; ignore only_task in _settle_wide_gates -> wgt2,wgt3 red; scoped call still runs _settle -> wgt2,wgt3 red (after adding a stale bug to the fixture; first version of the case survived); scoped call still re-mirrors stubs -> wgt2 red; unscoped call also skips _settle -> wgt4 red; drop the unknown-task refusal -> wgt6 red. Commands: sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py tests/test_audit_task.py exit 0 '2/2 files ok, 2408 cases'; _deps.py --register-citations exit 0 (0 found); ruff check exit 0; vermin exit 0 (323 files, min 3.8); release.py changelog-check ok. Dependants: drive-phase.py importers and audit-task.py importers (full-gate.py, run-test-gate.py, tests) call neither settle_stale_gate nor cmd_settle/_settle_wide_gates positionally in a changed way - _settle_wide_gates' new third parameter defaults to None and the one other caller is unchanged; settle without --task behaves exactly as before (wgt4/wg5-wg9 green); the vf grid (every unread flag refuses on every verb) stayed green with --task declared on settle only.
